verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at this story. The product line includes NFC models (the 'Nitrokey 3A NFC' shop listing and a community mention of a 'Nitrokey 3C NFC'), it ships FIDO2, and the docs have an 'Android / NitroPhone' section. Nothing documents tapping the key on a phone over NFC to sign in through mobile browsers or apps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of NFC tap-to-authenticate on phones, mobile browser/app compatibility details (Android/iOS), and hands-on or independent confirmation that NFC login works on mobile.

support.subject: As a power user, I can tap the key on my phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers and apps
